title: case_context
description: Output of the Intent Classifier Agent (P1). Consumed by the Dynamic Tool Selector (P2).

case_id.description: Unique identifier for this investigation run (UUID4)

case_type.description: Primary attack category inferred from the incident report

artifact_types.description: Evidence artifact types that should be analysed, in priority order

artifact_types_claimed.description: Artifact types the incident narrative claimed (before intersection with the evidence actually provided). Present only when the run knows which evidence files were supplied; lets the report flag narrative-over-claim.

hypotheses.description: Specific forensic hypotheses to investigate, ranked by likelihood

affected_systems.description: System identifiers (hostnames, IPs) mentioned in the incident report

known_bad_hosts.description: Optional per-case known-bad domains / IPs (threat-intel). Folded into the P4 IOC reputation match (issue 4.2) so evidence touching these hosts is boosted and tagged, on top of the static bad_hosts catalog.

classifier_confidence.description: LLM self-reported confidence in the case_type classification

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this context was generated

raw_incident_summary.description: One-sentence LLM summary of the incident report (for audit trail)

evidence_sources.description: Runtime enrichment (P3, autoforensiq.py): maps each tool name to the evidence file(s) it read, for source attribution in the report. Added after classification, so not in 'required'.

evidence_reconciliation.description: Runtime enrichment (P4, issue 1.1): full reconciliation block comparing the narrative classification against recovered evidence.

reconciled_confidence.description: Runtime enrichment: evidence-reconciled confidence (classifier_confidence is left untouched).

narrative_evidence_divergence.description: Runtime enrichment: true when recovered evidence fails to support the narrative classification.
